title: Storage-efficient CI, documentation gates and sustainable handover

changes.summary: Audit uploads for justification and max 3-day retention.
changes.checklist: Adopt the artifact checker in CI; remove redundant uploads and explicitly justify cross-job artifacts.

changes.summary: Document artifact publication and cleanup policy.
changes.checklist: Add docs/ARTIFACT_LIFECYCLE.md; prefer direct GitHub Releases over temporary Actions archives.

changes.summary: Preserve staging after promotion to main.
changes.checklist: Check staging protection and enable/test the preserve-staging workflow or a functionally equivalent mechanism.

changes.summary: Validate user documentation and release packages where applicable.
changes.checklist: Adopt user documentation checks for shipped apps; for desktop packaging ensure Windows smoke tests and documented outputs.

changes.summary: Optional provider-neutral review scaffold and issue dialog.
changes.checklist: Use advisory/fake provider by default until a real provider is configured, tested and explicitly approved.
